name: app-authentication-flow-in-blue-grey-gradient
title: Login, create-account, OTP and home screens with pale-to-slate gradient bottoms
whatItIs: An off-white page with a light and italic serif headline and four tilted-perspective phones arranged like a cross: welcome back, create account, OTP verification with a keypad, and home with balance. Each screen fades from near-white to slate blue at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Secure and calm; the fade toward blue suggests depth and trust.
techniques: Fade screens from white to slate at the bottom.
Arrange four screens in a cross around a centre.
Show OTP boxes and a translucent keypad.
Use small pill tabs to name each screen.

vocabulary.definition: A gradient darkening toward the screen bottom.
Boxes for entering a one-time code.
Four items placed around a centre.
